drums.tags: Funk-rock instrumental with a heavy emphasis on syncopated rhythmic interplay. The track features a clean, percussive electric guitar playing muted 16th-note scratches and staccato chords. A prominent electric bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking tightly with a dry, punchy drum kit. The drums utilize a crisp snare and a tight hi-hat pattern with occasional open accents. A bright, brassy synthesizer or horn section provides staccato melodic stabs. The arrangement is built on a repetitive, high-energy groove with sudden stops and rhythmic unisons. 115 BPM, E minor, 4/4 time signature.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[muted 16th-note electric guitar scratches]
[slap bass enters with syncopated octave jumps]
[drum kit enters with tight hi-hat and punchy snare]

[Main Groove]
[staccato electric guitar chords on the off-beats]
[slap bass continues with percussive ghost notes]
[bright synth stabs accenting the end of phrases]

[Breakdown]
[rhythmic unison hits between bass, drums, and guitar]
[brief drum fill with snare rolls]

[Outro]
[sustained synth chord fades]
[final staccato bass pop and snare hit]

bass.tags: Hard rock instrumental. Distorted electric guitars play syncopated power chord riffs and palm-muted rhythmic patterns. The bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns with a gritty, overdriven tone. Acoustic drums feature a heavy snare, active hi-hat work, and frequent crash cymbal accents. The arrangement alternates between driving riff-based sections and more open, rhythmic passages. 130 BPM, 4/4 time signature, E minor.
